title: PartsExport
description: Parts Export schema v1: every Part to be cut from one cabinet-planner Project, with sizes, Material, banding, position and machining, for a separate optimiser/CAM app. Lengths are integer micrometres everywhere. Read parts-export.v1.guide.md for the rules JSON Schema cannot express.

units.description: Every length in this file is an integer number of micrometres (19.6 mm is 19600).

exportedAt.description: When the file was written, UTC, RFC 3339.

library.description: The Library the Project's Cabinets were evaluated against.

materials.description: Only the Sheets and Edgebands some Part uses, copied from the Library's Catalogue. Sorted by id as the Library sorts ids.

rooms.description: Every Room that owns at least one exported or skipped Cabinet or Generated Item, in Project order.

cabinets.description: Every Cabinet that owns at least one exported Part.

generatedItems.description: Every Generated Item segment that owns at least one exported Part. A Generated Item that follows a Run Chain round a Corner is one entry per Wall Face, sharing `chain`.

parts.description: One entry per physical piece to cut. There is no quantity: identical pieces are separate entries.

skipped.description: Cabinets and Generated Items the user chose to export without. Empty when the job is complete.

SchemaVersion.description: Semver version of the Parts Export format this file conforms to. This schema accepts major version 1 only.

LibraryId.description: A Library id: a 64-bit snowflake written as a decimal string. Opaque.

Id.description: A planner id (Room, Wall, Cabinet, Generated Item or Part). Opaque: never parse it. Unique within its table in one file.

Length.description: A length or position in integer micrometres.

Size.description: A strictly positive length in integer micrometres.

Axis.description: A signed axis of the owner's frame.

Face.description: A face of a Part, named by its local axis as in the Library: `top`/`bottom` (normal ±Z), `x0`/`xL` the ends (normal −X/+X), `y0`/`yW` the long edges (normal −Y/+Y).

Edge.description: An edge of a Part, for banding and ends: `x0`/`xL` across the ends, `y0`/`yW` along the length.

FacePoint.description: A point on a Part face in the Part's own frame. Exactly the two axes of the face: `x`,`y` on top/bottom; `y`,`z` on x0/xL; `x`,`z` on y0/yW (guide, Machining).

WallFace.description: One side of a Wall: `left` or `right` as seen walking from its start Corner to its end Corner.

ToRoom.description: Places an owner's frame in its Room's frame: rotate the owner frame by `yaw` about +Y, then translate by `origin` (guide, Positions).

origin.description: Where the owner frame's origin lies in the Room frame.

yaw.description: Degrees counter-clockwise about +Y seen from above, 0 ≤ yaw < 360, rounded to 0.01°.

label.description: The Cabinet Label (`B3`), as stored in the Project. Unique in the file ignoring case.

folder.description: The Library Cabinet's Folder path, segments joined by `/` (`Kitchen/Base`). Empty at the Library root.

outsideBox.description: The Cabinet's Outside box in its own frame: evaluated Parts plus leg Hardware.

label.description: Derived, for people: the kind, the Label of its Run's first Cabinet, and the end or Cabinet where that applies (`Toe Kick B1`, `End Panel B1 start`, `Filler B2`). Not unique and not stable: match on `id`.

chain.description: Shared by the segments of one Generated Item that follows a Run Chain round Corners; null when it stays on one Wall Face.

Mitre.description: A mitred end, cut through the thickness in the Part's X–Z plane.

angle.description: Degrees away from a square cut, 0 < angle < 90, rounded to 0.01°.

longFace.description: The face on which this end reaches the long point; `length` is measured there.

Place.description: The Part in its owner's frame, as Library `place`: `at` is the minimum corner of its bounding box, `length` the owner axis local X follows, `top` the direction local Z (the top face) points. Local Y is top × length.

name.description: For a Cabinet Part, the Library Part name with the copy indices of every repeated entry, outermost first (`s0.shelf[2]`). For a Generated Item Part, its kind.

materialSlot.description: The Library Cabinet's Sheet slot name the Part is cut from (`carcass`). Cabinet Parts only.

length.description: Finished size along local X, banding included; to the long point of a mitred end. Authoritative.

width.description: Finished size along local Y, banding included. Authoritative.

cutLength.description: `length` minus the thickness of the Edgebands on `x0` and `xL`. No shop allowances.

cutWidth.description: `width` minus the thickness of the Edgebands on `y0` and `yW`. No shop allowances.

grain.description: Effective grain: `length` when local X must follow the Sheet's grain (the Part asks for it and the Sheet is grained); otherwise `none`, and nesting may rotate the Part.

edges.description: The Edgeband id on each banded edge. A missing key is an unbanded edge.

ends.description: Ends that are not square. Omitted when both are square.

ops.description: Every machining operation, fully evaluated and expanded: one entry per hole, groove or pocket.

Drill.description: A hole into `face` at `at`: vertical on top/bottom, horizontal on an edge. Exactly one of `depth` or `through`.

Groove.description: A straight slot on `face`; `from`/`to` are the ends of its centre line, the width centred on it.

Pocket.description: A rectangular recess on `face`, `length` along the face's u axis and `width` along v.

Source.description: Why the op exists. Consumers may ignore it.

OpSource.description: An operation the Library Cabinet's Author wrote on the Part.

index.description: The op's index in the Library Part's `ops`.

HardwareSource.description: A hole drilled for a Hardware placement's Mount (including holes-only placements such as Pin hole columns).

pattern.description: The drill pattern name on the item (`cup`, `plate`, `pin`).

placement.description: The placement copy, as a Library Violation subject: `hardware:<owner>/<index>` plus copy indices (`hardware:s0.door.leaf/0[1,0]`).

label.description: The Cabinet Label, or the Generated Item's derived label, as in `cabinets` and `generatedItems`.

name.description: The Library Cabinet's name, or the Generated Item's kind.

reason.description: `invalid`: a Cabinet with an error Violation. `placeholder`: a Cabinet whose Library Cabinet is missing. `noMaterial`: a Generated Item with no Material to cut from.
